title.english: The Cloth in the Sewing Tin

pairs.target: dìèrtiān shàngwǔ , tǎ wéi xiàng ruǎn héng shuō le qùchù , dài zhe xìn xià dào huī ào .
pairs.english: The next morning Tavi told Ruan Heng where he was going and took the letters down to Ash Hollow.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天上午，塔维向阮衡说了去处，带着信下到灰坳。

pairs.target: sè lākāi mén shí , shǒulǐ zhèng ná zhe nà jié lán huābù . tǎ wéi zhàn zài ménwài , xiān kànjiàn tā zhǐ jiān lùchū de zhēn wěi , cái xiǎngqǐ zìjǐ méi shuō jīntiān huílái .
pairs.english: When Sela opened the door she was holding the blue-flowered cloth. Outside, Tavi saw the needle end between her fingers before remembering he hadn't said he'd come home today.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉开门时，手里正拿着那截蓝花布。塔维站在门外，先看见她指间露出的针尾，才想起自己没说今天回来。

pairs.target: tā ràngkāi yìdiǎn , shuō guō lǐ zhǐyǒu zìjǐ de fàn , tā ruò kěn chī zuótiān de bǐng , jiù jìnlái . tǎ wéi jìn le mén , bēibāo gē zài lǎo dìfāng . " wǒ chī bǐng . "
pairs.english: She moved aside a little, saying there was only her own rice in the pot; if he'd eat yesterday's flatbread he could come in. Tavi entered and put his pack in its old place. “I'll eat flatbread.”
pairs.hanzi:
她让开一点，说锅里只有自己的饭，他若肯吃昨天的饼，就进来。
塔维进了门，背包搁在老地方。“我吃饼。”

pairs.target: sè lā què jiē le guōgài , jiāng fàn bō chū bànwǎn . tā shuō bù shì zǎoshàng gāng shōudào de , xìn xiān kàn le , bāofú què liú dào shǒutóu de yīfu fèng wán cái chāi .
pairs.english: Sela lifted the pot lid anyway and scooped out half a bowl of rice. The cloth had just arrived that morning; she'd read the note first but waited to finish her sewing before opening the parcel.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉却揭了锅盖，将饭拨出半碗。她说布是早上刚收到的，信先看了，包袱却留到手头的衣服缝完才拆。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yǐwéi tā yào bǎ bù jiǎnchéng liǎngtiáo , tā yǐ bǎ cháng biān xiàng lǐ zhé hǎo , zhēn zhā zài jiācéng , juǎn qǐlái shí zhēnjiān biàn búhuì dǐng chūqù .
pairs.english: Tavi thought she'd cut it into two strips, but she'd already folded the long edge inward, needles tucked between layers so their points wouldn't poke out when rolled.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维以为她要把布剪成两条，她已把长边向里折好，针扎在夹层，卷起来时针尖便不会顶出去。

pairs.target: " huā cháowài háishì cháolǐ ? " tā wèn . " cháowài . cháolǐ gěi zhēn kàn ? "
pairs.english: “Flowers facing out or in?” he asked. “Out. In so the needles can look at them?”
pairs.hanzi:
“花朝外还是朝里？”他问。
“朝外。朝里给针看？”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiào , shēnshǒu tì tā bǎ sàn zhe de xiàn lǒng dào yìbiān . zhuōshàng nà jiàn yīfu shì gébì háizi de , zhǒubù mó chū yíkuài liàng , sè lā zhèngzài xiàmiàn chèn xīn bù .
pairs.english: Tavi laughed and gathered her loose thread aside. The garment on the table belonged to the neighbor's child, its elbow worn shiny; Sela was lining it underneath with new cloth.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维笑，伸手替她把散着的线拢到一边。桌上那件衣服是隔壁孩子的，肘部磨出一块亮，瑟拉正在下面衬新布。

pairs.target: tā jìde xìn lǐ shuō gēbo kuài tóng zìjǐ dāngnián yíyàng cháng , rújīn zhēn jiàn zhe , háishì jiāng zìjǐ de xiùzǐ āi guòqù bǐ le bǐ , chà le yì jié , bùzhī shì háizi hái méi cháng gòu , háishì zìjǐ yòu cháng le .
pairs.english: He remembered the letter saying those arms were nearly as long as his back then. Seeing it now, he compared his sleeve anyway: a section short, whether because the child hadn't grown enough or he had grown again.
pairs.hanzi: 他记得信里说胳膊快同自己当年一样长，如今真见着，还是将自己的袖子挨过去比了比，差了一截，不知是孩子还没长够，还是自己又长了。

pairs.target: sè lā kànzhe tā bǐ , méiyǒu lìkè shuōhuà . tā ràng tā zhàn zhídào ménkuàng biān , táishǒu xiǎng zhǎo cóngqián liáng guò de nà dào xiàn , zhǎo le yíhuìer , yuánlái xiàn zǎo gěi hòulái shuā shàng de huī gàizhù le .
pairs.english: Sela watched without speaking immediately. She had him stand straight by the doorframe and reached for the old height mark, searching a while before realizing it had long been covered by a later coat of plaster.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉看着他比，没有立刻说话。她让他站直到门框边，抬手想找从前量过的那道线，找了一会儿，原来线早给后来刷上的灰盖住了。

pairs.target: liǎng rén duì zhe ménkuàng zhàn le yíhuìer , zuìhòu tā shuō suànle , yīfu bù duǎn biàn xíng , zhuǎnshēn qù ná wǎn .
pairs.english: They stood facing the doorframe a while. Finally she said never mind, as long as his clothes weren't short, and turned to fetch bowls.
pairs.hanzi: 两人对着门框站了一会儿，最后她说算了，衣服不短便行，转身去拿碗。

pairs.target: chīguòfàn , tǎ wéi bǎ nài lěi de yuán xìn hé xuégōng tóngyì de fù yè qǔchū lái , tān zài méi zhānyóu de zhuō jiǎo .
pairs.english: After eating Tavi took out Nerai's original letter and the academy approval copy, laying them on a grease-free table corner.
pairs.hanzi: 吃过饭，塔维把奈蕾的原信和学宫同意的副页取出来，摊在没沾油的桌角。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu zhī shuō yào gēn yuèjiè kè chūqù , yě méiyǒu bǎ bātiān shuō chéng qù kàn fú wū de yóuwán .
pairs.english: He didn't merely say he was going with an Outrider, nor call the eight days a sightseeing trip to floating houses.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有只说要跟越界客出去，也没有把八天说成去看浮屋的游玩。

pairs.target: sè lā dú dé màn , tā jiù zài pángbiān jiāng tā bù shú de dìmíng niàn yíbiàn , děng tā dú dào nà zhī wūdǐng shàng de jī , zìjǐ yě gēnzhe kàn le yìyǎn .
pairs.english: Sela read slowly, and he pronounced unfamiliar place names beside her. When she reached the chicken on the roof, he looked at it too.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉读得慢，他就在旁边将她不熟的地名念一遍，等她读到那只屋顶上的鸡，自己也跟着看了一眼。

pairs.target: " wǒhuì xiān huí fēng zhàn , zài cóng bái péng yì huìhé . " tā shuō , " búshì qù sōng dī . "
pairs.english: “I'll return to Wind Trestle first, then meet her at White Awning Station,” he said. “Not go to Songdi.”
pairs.hanzi: “我会先回风栈，再从白棚驿会合。”他说，“不是去松堤。”

pairs.target: sè lā de zhǐjiān zài sōng dī èr zì méi chūxiàn de dìfāng tíngzhù . tā yǐjīng shōudào tā jì lái de xīn xiāoxī , chí ān , xǔ lián hé nà fēng liùzhōu qián de xìn , dōu chāo zài lìng yìzhāng zhǐ shàng .
pairs.english: Sela's fingertip stopped where Songdi hadn't appeared. She'd already received his news; Chian, Xu Lian, and the six-week-old letter were copied on another sheet.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉的指尖在松堤二字没出现的地方停住。她已经收到他寄来的新消息，迟安、许莲和那封六周前的信，都抄在另一张纸上。

pairs.target: tā shuō zìjǐ zhè jǐrì měi huí chūmén dǎo huī , dōu xiǎng kànkàn lùkǒu yǒuméiyǒu sòngxìn de rén , míngzhī nàlǐ búshì gěi xuégōng sòngxìn de lù .
pairs.english: She said each time she'd gone to empty ashes these past days she'd wanted to check the junction for a post carrier, knowing it wasn't the road for academy mail.
pairs.hanzi: 她说自己这几日每回出门倒灰，都想看看路口有没有送信的人，明知那里不是给学宫送信的路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yě zhème děng guò , yìshí bùzhī gāi zěnyàng quàn . zuìhòu zhī shuō ruò yǒu huíxìn , zìjǐ huì bǎ zhěngfēng gěi tā kàn , bù zhī tiāo yíjù hǎotīng de .
pairs.english: Tavi had waited like that too and didn't know how to comfort her. Finally he only said if an answer came, he'd show her the whole letter, not just choose a pleasing sentence.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维也这么等过，一时不知该怎样劝。最后只说若有回信，自己会把整封给她看，不只挑一句好听的。

pairs.target: sè lā diǎntóu , cóng zhēnxiàn guàn lǐ qǔchū fú lán nà fēng jiù xìn , méiyǒu dìgěi tā , xiān jiāng guàn kǒu de yìgēn xiàn zhāidiào .
pairs.english: Sela nodded and took Fulan's old letter from the sewing tin, first removing a thread from the rim rather than handing it to him.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉点头，从针线罐里取出芙兰那封旧信，没有递给他，先将罐口的一根线摘掉。

pairs.target: tā wèn tā zhèhuí hái xiǎng buxiǎng dài . tā yáotóu , shuō zìjǐ yǒu fùběn , yuánlái de liúzài zhèlǐ . tā biàn jiāng xìn chóngxīn fàng hǎo , jiāng lán huāzhēn bāo yě gē jìnqù , liǎngyàng dōngxī dōu méi zài wǎnglǐmiàn cáng .
pairs.english: She asked if he wanted to take it this time. He shook his head: he had a copy; the original could stay here. She put it away again, adding the blue-flowered needle roll without hiding either deeper inside.
pairs.hanzi: 她问他这回还想不想带。他摇头，说自己有副本，原来的留在这里。她便将信重新放好，将蓝花针包也搁进去，两样东西都没再往里面藏。

pairs.target: wǔhòu liǎng rén bǎ zhuōzi nuó dào chuāng biān . tā tì tā tuōzhù yī zhǒu lǐ de chènbù , tā cóng wàitou xià zhēn , jǐcì xiǎnxiē zhā dào tā de zhǐjiǎ , xián tā de shǒu bǐ xiǎoshíhòu zhàn dìfāng .
pairs.english: That afternoon they moved the table to the window. He held the elbow lining while she stitched from outside, nearly pricking his nails several times and complaining his hands took more room than in childhood.
pairs.hanzi: 午后两人把桌子挪到窗边。他替她托住衣肘里的衬布，她从外头下针，几次险些扎到他的指甲，嫌他的手比小时候占地方。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn ruòzhēn zhǎngdà le , shìfǒu jiù búyòng zuò zhè huó . tā shuō nà zhènghǎo , shǒu cháng , gòu dé yuǎn , chuángdǐ nà zhī diào le jiǎodiàn de xiāngzǐ yě gāi tuōchūlái .
pairs.english: Tavi asked if growing up meant he needn't do this work anymore. She said quite the opposite: long hands reached farther, and he should drag out the chest under the bed that had lost its foot pad too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问若真长大了，是否就不用做这活。她说那正好，手长，够得远，床底那只掉了脚垫的箱子也该拖出来。

pairs.target: xiāngzǐ hěn qīng , kǎzhù tā de shì sǎojìnqù de yìbǎ suì zhú xiè .
pairs.english: The chest was light, caught only by a handful of swept-in bamboo chips.
pairs.hanzi: 箱子很轻，卡住它的是扫进去的一把碎竹屑。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiāng zhú xiè qīng chūlái , chóngxīn diànpíng , jiàn lǐmiàn hái liú zhe jǐjiàn bùhéshēn de jiùyī . tā méiyǒu yíjiànjiàn ná chūlái zhǎo shì nǎyìnián , sè lā yě méi cuī tā rēng . liǎng rén bǎ xiāngzǐ tuījìn qù , zhècì méi xiǎng .
pairs.english: Tavi cleared the chips and leveled it, seeing outgrown old clothes still inside. He didn't pull them out one by one to date them, nor did Sela urge him to throw them away. They pushed the chest back; this time it was quiet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维将竹屑清出来，重新垫平，见里面还留着几件不合身的旧衣。他没有一件件拿出来找是哪一年，瑟拉也没催他扔。两人把箱子推进去，这次没响。

pairs.target: línzǒuqián tā shuōmíng bàngwǎn yào huí xuégōng , míngtiān háiyǒu kè , dòngshēn qián ruò néng zài lái huì xiān tuōrén shuō , bú jiào tā bèi fàn .
pairs.english: Before leaving he explained he had to return to the academy that evening for lessons tomorrow. If he could visit again before departure he'd send word first, not have her prepare food.
pairs.hanzi: 临走前他说明傍晚要回学宫，明天还有课，动身前若能再来会先托人说，不叫她备饭。

pairs.target: sè lā jiāng shèngxià bànkuài bǐng bāo gěi tā , shuō zhèkuài yuánlái jiùshì zuótiān de , bié dàidào dìèrtiān zài dāng xīnxiān de sòng rén .
pairs.english: Sela wrapped the remaining half flatbread for him, saying it was already yesterday's, so don't keep it until tomorrow and give it away as fresh.
pairs.hanzi: 瑟拉将剩下半块饼包给他，说这块原来就是昨天的，别带到第二天再当新鲜的送人。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò lái , zǒu le liǎngbù yòu huítóu . sè lā hái zhàn zài mén lǐ , zhēn bāo yǐ bú zài shǒushàng , mǔzhǐ què bǎochí zhe niān zhēn de yàngzi .
pairs.english: Tavi took it and looked back after two steps. Sela still stood in the doorway, no longer holding the needle roll, yet her thumb kept its needle-holding shape.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过来，走了两步又回头。瑟拉还站在门里，针包已不在手上，拇指却保持着拈针的样子。

pairs.target: tā wèn tā gāngcái chèn de nà kuài bù , huāwén shìbushì wāi le yìdiǎn . tā mī yǎnkàn tā , hūrán yě xiào , shuō zhēn xiǎng tiāomáobìng , xiàhuí jiù zuò dào chīwǎnfàn zài zǒu .
pairs.english: He asked whether the pattern on the lining she'd just sewn was a little crooked. She narrowed her eyes at him, then laughed too: if he really wanted to find fault, next time he should stay until dinner.
pairs.hanzi: 他问她刚才衬的那块布，花纹是不是歪了一点。她眯眼看他，忽然也笑，说真想挑毛病，下回就坐到吃晚饭再走。

pairs.target: huídào xuégōng shí tiān hái liàng zhe , pà wò zhèngzài chuāng biān mó mùbǎn . tǎ wéi jiāng bǐng bāi gěi tā bànkuài , xiān shuō shì zuótiān de . pà wò kàn le yìyǎn , shuō láng bù tiāo rìzi , rén tiāo , jiēzhe bǎ bǐng názǒu le .
pairs.english: It was still daylight when he returned to the academy. Pavo was sanding a board by the window. Tavi broke him half the bread, first saying it was yesterday's. Pavo glanced at it, said wolves didn't care about dates but people did, and took it.
pairs.hanzi: 回到学宫时天还亮着，帕沃正在窗边磨木板。塔维将饼掰给他半块，先说是昨天的。帕沃看了一眼，说狼不挑日子，人挑，接着把饼拿走了。
